<result>**Short answer:** The "Edit cloud environment" dialog configures an Anthropic-hosted environment. Sessions under it run on Anthropic's VMs, not on your server. Your server can be used in three ways, and only one of them is that dialog's job.

| Goal | Option | Plan needed |
|---|---|---|
| Cloud-session semantics, runs on your server | 1. Self-hosted environment | Team or Enterprise (public beta, off by default) |
| Desktop Code tab drives Claude Code on the server | 2. Desktop SSH connection | Any plan that runs Desktop |
| Steer a server-side Claude Code from claude.ai/code or the phone app | 3. Remote Control | Pro, Max, Team, or Enterprise |

## 1. Self-hosted environments (yes, they exist)

Docs: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/self-hosted-environments and the quickstart https://code.claude.com/docs/en/self-hosted-environments-quickstart.md

**Server prerequisites**
- Linux or macOS. Windows is not supported as a runner host.
- Claude Code v2.1.224+, installed by any standard method (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup.md). Check with `claude self-hosted-runner --help`.
- Git 2.24+.
- Outbound HTTPS to `api.anthropic.com`, `claude.ai`, and your git host. Clock within 5 minutes of real time.
- The repo must clone over HTTPS without a password prompt. An SSH key alone is not enough unless you rewrite URLs (see the deploy page).

**Steps**
1. An Owner opens https://claude.ai/admin-settings/cloud-environments and turns on **Allow self-hosted environments**.
2. On that page, under **Self-hosted environments**, click **New**, name it, click **Create**, then **Copy environment key**. The key is shown once.
3. On the server:
   ```bash
   mkdir -p /etc/claude
   (umask 077 && cat > /etc/claude/environment-secret)
   # paste the key, Enter, then Ctrl-D
   claude self-hosted-runner --environment-secret-file '/etc/claude/environment-secret' --base-dir '/srv/claude-runner'
   ```
   Use a dedicated `--base-dir`, never your home directory or a folder of your own clones. The runner treats `<base>/<owner>/<repo>` as its own and can overwrite it.
   Alternative: `claude self-hosted-runner setup` (guided; needs an Owner sign-in via `claude auth login` on that machine).
4. The page should change from "No runners deployed" to Healthy. The log shows `Registered: runner_id=...`.
5. Go to https://claude.ai/code, start a session, and pick the environment from the environment picker. The Desktop app's cloud selector lists these too, per the Availability section.

**Caveats**
- The runner exits after serving one session. Restart it, or run it under systemd or an orchestrator (docs: deploy page).
- Network access, network secrets, and the Anthropic-hosted "Edit cloud environment" settings do not apply. The docs say self-hosted environments have no network secrets. I did not read the configuration page (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/self-hosted-environments-configuration.md), so I can't confirm how setup scripts and env vars are set for runners.
- Sessions bill against your organization's Claude Code usage.

## 2. Desktop SSH connection

Docs: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/desktop.md (SSH sessions section)

**UI steps (Code tab)**
1. Open the environment selector under the prompt box, then **New environment** at the bottom of the menu.
2. On the **SSH** tab, open **Host**, choose **Add SSH connection…**.
3. Fill in Name, SSH host (`user@host` or a `~/.ssh/config` alias), SSH port (22), SSH key (optional, e.g. `~/.ssh/id_ed25519`), and Worktree folder (e.g. `~/worktrees`).
4. Click **Add SSH connection**, pick a folder on the remote, click **Create environment**, type the task, press Enter.

**Remote requirements (from the docs)**
- Linux or macOS, x86_64 or arm64; glibc 2.17+ or musl.
- SFTP subsystem enabled in `sshd_config` (`Subsystem sftp`). Test with `sftp` from your PC.
- `MaxSessions` at least 2 (default 10), unless Desktop is v3.1623.0+ on macOS/Linux.
- `~/.claude/remote/` must not be on a `noexec` mount; about 1 GB per user.
- A shell that runs commands sent over SSH (bash, zsh, sh).
- Network access so Desktop can download Claude Code. If the remote can't, Desktop downloads it locally and uploads it.
- Desktop installs Claude Code automatically on first connect, under `~/.claude/remote/`, as the SSH user, without sudo.
- Use a key in ssh-agent so the login needs no prompt. One-time codes break `!` commands.
- Host key: run `ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_<type>_key.pub` on the server, compare the fingerprint, then **Trust and connect**.

**Where the docs are silent**
- Node.js is not mentioned.
- The docs don't say how Claude Code on the remote gets signed in. The part I read only says Desktop renews the claude.ai sign-in while it is connected, so a session stops when the token expires after disconnect.
- On Windows, Desktop uses its built-in SSH client unless Microsoft OpenSSH 9.4+ is installed and Desktop came from the download buttons, not the Store. The built-in client ignores `CertificateFile` and fails with `ProxyJump`.

**My recommendation, not from the docs:** create a non-root user on the server for Claude sessions and connect as that user. Claude Code runs with that user's rights.

## 3. Remote Control on the server

Docs: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/remote-control.md

```bash
# on the server, as the user who will run it
curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash   # or the method in https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup.md
claude          # then /login (claude.ai account; API keys are not supported)
cd /srv/alpha   # project directory
tmux new -s rc  # keeps it alive after SSH disconnects (docs recommend this)
claude remote-control --name "alpha"
```

- The first run asks `Enable Remote Control? (y/n)` and `Trust <dir>? [y/N]`. Answer `y`, or the command exits when there is no terminal.
- Connect from https://claude.ai/code or the Claude mobile app. Press spacebar for a QR code.
- Team and Enterprise: an Owner must enable **Remote Control** at https://claude.ai/admin-settings/claude-code.
- Flags include `--name`, `--capacity` (default 32), and `--spawn <mode>`. Run `claude remote-control --help` for the full list.
- The process must keep running. Work stays on the server, with the server's files, MCP servers, and tools.
- Remote Control does not give you the Desktop Code tab UI. Use option 2 for that.
- The curl install line above is a placeholder. Use the install method on https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup.md.

**Sources**
- https://code.claude.com/docs/en/self-hosted-environments
- https://code.claude.com/docs/en/self-hosted-environments-quickstart.md
- https://code.claude.com/docs/en/self-hosted-environments-deploy.md
- https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-code-on-the-web.md
- https://code.claude.com/docs/en/desktop.md
- https://code.claude.com/docs/en/remote-control.md
- https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup.md

If any of this doesn't match your build or plan, report it with `/feedback`.</result>

lastPrompt: как сделать так чтобы открыть claude на сервере кальк? мне нужно сделать там клодовское облачное подключение

content.text:
Окно на скриншоте не подходит: среды в нём работают на серверах Anthropic. Claude на сервер счёта можно поставить одним из трёх способов:

**1. SSH-подключение в Claude Desktop — самый простой.** Вкладка Code работает прямо на сервере.
1. Во вкладке Code откройте выбор среды под полем ввода и нажмите **New environment**.
2. Перейдите на вкладку **SSH**, затем **Host** → **Add SSH connection…**.
3. Заполните: хост `root@89.163.242.211`, порт 22, ключ `~/.ssh/id_rsa`, папку для рабочих копий, например `~/worktrees`.
4. Нажмите **Add SSH connection**, выберите папку на сервере и нажмите **Create environment**.

Claude Code приложение поставит на сервер само, в `~/.claude/remote/`. На сервере должен быть включён SFTP (`Subsystem sftp` в `sshd_config`). Совет: заведите для Claude отдельного пользователя, а не root.

**2. Сервер как «своя» облачная среда (self-hosted)** — только на тарифах Team или Enterprise, в бета-версии.
1. Включите в https://claude.ai/admin-settings/cloud-environments пункт **Allow self-hosted environments**.
2. Там же нажмите **New** и скопируйте ключ среды.
3. На сервере запустите:

```bash
claude self-hosted-runner --environment-secret-file /etc/claude/environment-secret --base-dir /srv/claude-runner
```

Сетевые секреты из вашего окна к такой среде не применяются.

**3. Remote Control.** Ставите Claude Code на сервер, выполняете `claude remote-control` внутри `tmux` и управляете с claude.ai/code или с телефона.

Подробности — в документации: [desktop.md](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/desktop.md) (раздел про SSH) и [self-hosted-environments](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/self-hosted-environments).

Контекст этой сессии дошёл примерно до 400 тыс., пора сделать клир. Блокнот обновил и запушил: команда остановлена, итоги дня и открытые вопросы записаны. После клира наберите `/ceo`.
